# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 rendering corrections** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the renderer to Skia m153 and incorporates native lifetime and GPU correctness fixes. Linux font fallback can choose a different face. HarfBuzzSharp uses a new package revision bucket, not a new native engine version.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux fallback font selection may change** — Fontconfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family/style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to m153** — Advances the bundled renderer without managed API or native C ABI changes. HarfBuzzSharp package revision .300 still uses native HarfBuzz 14.2.1. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas and GPU failure handling corrected** — Prevents stale atlas reuse after partial glyph updates, propagates failed native flushes, and rejects incomplete GPU-buffer uploads under memory pressure. Managed flush signatures remain unchanged. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Cached-data cleanup releases the mutex before deletion** — Avoids unlocking a mutex through freed storage when SkCachedData is released. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007** — Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.
